summary.zhCn: Dogecoin 共同创建者和初始客户端主要实现者；曾任 IBM 软件工程师，约2015年退出项目并处置大部分早期加密资产。
summary.en: Dogecoin co-creator and principal implementer of its initial client; a former IBM software engineer who left the project and disposed of most early crypto holdings around 2015.
